rules.intraday: Bought at the open of the first 5-minute bar after the alert, not at the level. First target 1.5R (half booked, stop to the price paid), second 3R, out by 3:15 PM. Results are after costs of 0.1% of the trade's value.
rules.swing: Triggered within 3 sessions above the setup level (filled at the open if it gaps above); half booked at the first target and the stop on the rest moved to the price paid. Pullback and tight base: targets 2R and 3R, out at the 10th session. CANSLIM: stop 8% below, targets +20% and +25% (O'Neil). Minervini: stop below the last contraction (8% at most), targets 2R and 3R. Both held up to 30 sessions. Results are after costs of 0.3% of the trade's value.
